concepts.title: ACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Step-by-step procedure to activate and configure the NR Downlink Beam Optimizer feature.

concepts.title: DEACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Step-by-step procedure to deactivate the NR Downlink Beam Optimizer and optionally restore the default grid.

concepts.title: Feature Dependencies
concepts.description: Details the feature, hardware, and network dependencies, as well as limitations of the NR Downlink Beam Optimizer.

concepts.title: Feature Operation
concepts.description: Describes the evaluation cycle, scoring mechanism, open/closed-loop modes, and rollback behavior of the NR Downlink Beam Optimizer.

concepts.title: Feature Overview
concepts.description: NR Downlink Beam Optimizer continuously observes per-beam performance measurements in Massive MIMO cells and adapts the SSB beam configuration to match the actual spatial distribution of traffic.

concepts.title: Network Impact
concepts.description: Analyzes the impact of the NR Downlink Beam Optimizer on coverage, mobility, end users, and KPIs.

concepts.title: Parameters
concepts.description: Configuration parameters for the NR Downlink Beam Optimizer, including operating modes, evaluation periods, and rollback thresholds.

concepts.title: Performance Management
concepts.description: Performance management, KPIs, and counters for monitoring and supervising the NR Downlink Beam Optimizer.
